The sheet's header sits on row 4 under a description banner, so the loader reads columns as Unnamed: 0 to 18 with banner and header rows as data and numeric columns as text; the paper's models (trait ~ latitude + sex + (1 | pop), pop = population) cannot be rendered on named columns.
Index sheet describing the other sheets, no observations.
